Section 4.3.1
The equipment shall be constructed of non-corrosive materials as specified
in Section 4.3.1 and shall operate at a maximum voltage of 24 V.
Section 4.3.1 (Continued)
Non-corrosive construction is defined in Table 4-1 as either stainless steel
grade 316L or aluminum alloy 6061-T6. The voltage rating shall not exceed
24 V under all operating conditions.
